==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Puppeteer&min=Puppeteer&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/PuppeteerTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Puppeteer&min=Puppeteer&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using PuppeteerSharp;

// Verify.Puppeteer: Verifies a PuppeteerSharp page or element as both its html and a screenshot png.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.HeadlessBrowsers
// Note: Each verification writes two files: the html and a png screenshot.
// Note: Screenshots vary between operating systems and renderers, so an image comparer, or
// VerifierSettings.UseSsimForPng(...), is what keeps CI stable.
// Note: --disable-lcd-text makes text rendering reproducible; existing screenshots have to be
// re-accepted once after adding it.
// Note: PuppeteerSharp's Puppeteer class and the VerifyTests.Puppeteer namespace have the same
// name, so importing both makes every use of Puppeteer ambiguous.
// Note: SocketWaiter is defined separately by each of the three headless browser packages, here in
// VerifyTests.Puppeteer.
// Note: The assembly is not strong named, and the package targets net10.0 only.
public class PuppeteerTests
{
    // Two files are written: the page html and a png screenshot.
    // PuppeteerSharp's Puppeteer class and the VerifyTests.Puppeteer namespace share a name, so
    // both are written out in full rather than imported.
    // Not run by default: downloads a browser on first run, and needs the site under test listening on
    // http://localhost:5000
    [Fact(Skip = "downloads a browser on first run, and needs the site under test listening on http://localhost:5000")]
    public async Task Page()
    {
        // Downloads the browser if it is not already there, then waits for the site under test.
        await new BrowserFetcher(SupportedBrowser.Chrome).DownloadAsync();
        await VerifyTests.Puppeteer.SocketWaiter.Wait(port: 5000);

        await using var browser = await PuppeteerSharp.Puppeteer.LaunchAsync(
            new()
            {
                Browser = SupportedBrowser.Chrome,
                Args = ["--disable-lcd-text"]
            });
        await using var page = await browser.NewPageAsync();
        await page.GoToAsync("http://localhost:5000");

        await Verify(page);
    }
}

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: Puppeteer needs A Chrome download: PuppeteerSharp downloads its own Chrome through BrowserFetcher on first use, and the samples also need the site under test running.
